name: HSE Foundation Awareness
description: Foundational HSE awareness covering site safety rules, emergency procedures, hazard recognition, PPE usage, and personal responsibility. Mandatory for all persons entering operational areas.

regulatory_references.requirement: Worker information on hazards and precautions

name: Confined Space Entrant - Level 1
description: Authorized to enter routine confined spaces under permit. Covers atmospheric testing awareness, escape procedures, communication protocols, and PPE for confined space entry.

name: Confined Space Entrant - Level 2 (High Hazard)
description: Authorized to enter high-hazard confined spaces including IDLH atmospheres, requires SCBA proficiency and rescue capability.

name: Confined Space Attendant
description: Authorized to serve as attendant for confined space entries. Covers continuous monitoring, communication, emergency response activation, and standby rescue.

name: Hot Work - SMAW Welder
description: Authorized to perform Shielded Metal Arc Welding (SMAW/Stick) under PTW. Covers technique proficiency, fire safety in hot work, and welding-specific PPE.

name: Hot Work - GMAW Welder
description: Authorized to perform Gas Metal Arc Welding (MIG/MAG).

name: Hot Work - GTAW Welder
description: Authorized to perform Gas Tungsten Arc Welding (TIG). Higher precision welding for stainless steel, aluminum, and critical applications.

name: Hot Work - Oxy-Fuel Cutting
description: Authorized to perform oxy-acetylene/LPG cutting. Covers gas cylinder handling, regulator setup, flame adjustment.

name: Work at Height - Basic
description: Authorized for routine work at heights between 2-10 meters. Covers harness usage, anchor point identification, ladder safety.

name: Work at Height - Advanced (Rope Access)
description: Authorized for work at heights >10m, work over edges, rope access. Industrial rope access technician (IRATA Level 1 equivalent).

name: Electrical Authorized Person - Low Voltage
description: Authorized to work on electrical systems up to 1000V AC / 1500V DC. Covers LOTO, electrical PPE, arc flash awareness.

name: Electrical Authorized Person - High Tension
description: Authorized to work on HT systems >1000V. Requires Electrical Supervisor Certificate of Competency under state Electrical Inspectorate.

name: Lockout-Tagout Authorized Person
description: Authorized to apply and remove locks/tags on energy isolation devices.

name: Rigging - Basic
description: Authorized for basic rigging of loads up to 5MT. Covers sling selection, hitch types, load calculation, communication with crane operator.

name: Rigging - Advanced (Critical Lifts)
description: Authorized for critical lifts including multi-crane lifts, lifts >50MT, lifts near energized equipment.

name: Mobile Crane Operator
description: Authorized to operate mobile/truck-mounted cranes.

name: Overhead/EOT Crane Operator
description: Authorized to operate overhead and EOT cranes from cabin or floor controls.

name: Forklift Operator
description: Authorized to operate counterbalance forklifts.

name: Mobile Elevating Work Platform Operator
description: Authorized to operate scissor lifts, boom lifts, articulating MEWPs.

name: Fire Warden
description: Authorized to lead floor/area evacuation during fire emergencies. Covers evacuation procedures, head count, communication with Fire Marshal.

name: First Aider
description: Authorized to provide first aid in the workplace. St. John Ambulance Standard First Aid certification or equivalent.

name: Emergency Rescue Team Member
description: Trained for confined space rescue, height rescue, fire rescue. Member of plant emergency rescue team.

name: Gas Tester
description: Authorized to perform pre-entry and continuous atmospheric testing for O2, LEL, H2S, CO. Covers calibration, bump testing, interpretation.

name: Permit to Work Issuer
description: Authorized to issue permits to work after risk review. Covers PTW procedure, JSA review, hazard recognition, control verification.

name: Permit to Work Authorizer (High-Risk)
description: Authorized to authorize high-risk permits (confined space high-hazard, HT electrical, hot work in process areas).

name: Incident Investigator
description: Authorized to conduct incident investigations including evidence gathering, witness interviews, RCA facilitation.

name: Root Cause Analysis Methods
description: Proficient in multiple RCA methodologies: 5-Why, Fishbone, FTA, Bowtie, TapRoot, 8D.

name: HIRA Study Facilitator
description: Authorized to lead HIRA studies. Covers methodology rigor, team facilitation, control hierarchy enforcement.

name: ISO 45001 Internal Auditor
description: Qualified to conduct internal audits of OH&S management system per ISO 45001:2018.

name: ISO 45001 Lead Auditor
description: Lead auditor qualification per IRCA or equivalent body. Authorized to lead third-party or major internal audits.

name: Emergency Response Management
description: Authorized to manage on-site emergency response. Covers ICS, evacuation management, regulator notification, crisis communication.

name: Radiation Safety Officer (RSO)
description: AERB-licensed RSO for facilities using ionizing radiation (radiography, density gauges).

name: Hazardous Chemical Handling
description: Authorized to handle hazardous chemicals. Covers SDS interpretation, PPE selection, spill response, decontamination.

name: Industrial Diver
description: Commercial/industrial diving operations including underwater inspection, salvage.

name: Demolition Supervisor
description: Authorized to supervise demolition work including structural assessment, sequencing, dust suppression.

name: Cement Kiln Operator
description: Authorized to operate cement kiln including burner management, feed control, draft management, emission monitoring.

name: Central Control Room Operator
description: DCS/control room operations including alarm management, process trending, plant startup/shutdown sequences.

name: Boiler Operator
description: Authorized to operate boilers per Indian Boilers Act. Boiler Attendant Certificate required.

name: NDT - Magnetic Particle Testing Level II
NDT - Liquid Penetrant Testing Level II
Control Valve and Manual Valve Maintenance
